author: Ubisoft
description:
Passion Meets Craft explores the people, dedication and intent driving creativity around games. Today, through @littlesiha’s approach to scoring in Just Dance.

Scoring a perfect move isn't luck, it's craft. 🎯
For @Littlesiha, Just Dance has always been about precision as much as passion. She knows exactly what it takes to score big: timing, technique, and hours of practice.
In this newest episode of Passion Meets Craft with the Just Dance team, @Littlesiha breaks down her own approach to scoring, while the teams at Ubisoft behind Just Dance reveal just how much precision sits behind every point. Through the years, the game has had to keep pace with evolving consoles, with some systems being discontinued along the way, pushing the team to build its own camera scoring technology to keep that same precision alive, move for move.
